label: The former and the latter rain together, another wave of glory
description: Reported 24 September 2025 as the Spirit saying this is the former and the latter rain together and another wave of the glory is coming upon the nations of the earth, followed by the rain beginning. The phrase is from Joel 2 and carries no date.
aliases: upon the nations of the earth

label: A tidal wave of glory about to hit Asia
description: A window of opportunity for the Asians with a major harvest of souls in the Asian community, described as a major tidal wave of the glory about to hit Asia, given alongside the argument that the return waits because North Korea has not yet had its opportunity.
aliases: harvest of souls in the Asian community
window of opportunity for the Asians

label: Genetic code work in Japan and China without restraint
description: Genetic code work seen under way in Japan, China and elsewhere, with foreign countries said to have no restraints where he doubts the United States would move as fast.
aliases: genetic code in Japan and in China

label: A first wave, then a greater wave behind it
description: A great shaking coming to America described as a first wave, with the tidal wave coming into shore and a greater wave behind it as it draws back. The two-wave structure means any first event can be called the first wave, which is why it cannot expire.
aliases: this should be a first wave
tidal wave will come into the shore
